slides.title:
Your PhD is industry-ready.
Your resume isn't.
slides.say: Your P H D is industry ready. Your resume isn't. Here are three fixes recruiters notice in seconds.

slides.title: Keep it to 2 pages.
slides.body: Recruiters skim. Put your full publication list on LinkedIn, not your resume.
slides.say: Fix one. Keep it to two pages. Recruiters skim, so put your full publication list on LinkedIn, not your resume.

slides.title: Start every bullet with a strong verb.
slides.say: Fix two. Start every bullet with a strong verb. Not, responsible for lab instruments. Instead, ran three instruments supporting five projects.

slides.title: Add a number to half your bullets.
slides.body: Samples run. People trained. Time saved. Numbers show impact.
slides.say: Fix three. Add a number to half your bullets. Samples run, people trained, time saved. Numbers show impact.
